verdict.rationale: incident.io has its own automation engine: Workflows can automatically publish to the status page when an incident updates, and it can auto-start a Teams meeting per incident. Investigations also start automatically when an incident is declared, gathering context including runbooks, code and telemetry, which loosely covers automatic diagnostics. However, there is no evidence of runbooks attaching to incidents as executable step lists. missing for 10: runbook objects attached to incidents, automatically triggered runbook steps, automatic channel creation, automatic task assignment, documentation of Workflows' trigger/step model, independent or hands-on corroboration.
